question: Should I lime this field?
answer:
Soil pH is 8.8 (SSURGO soil survey), which is strongly alkaline. Because agricultural lime raises soil pH [S1], liming this field is not appropriate and would make the soil even more alkaline. 

To manage high soil pH, consult your local agricultural extension office and obtain a targeted soil test to see if acidifying amendments are recommended for your alfalfa crop.
